summary.intent: Complete milestone v1.1 by discussing, planning, and executing three UAT gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling), then open a PR for the fully-verified Phase 42.
summary.outcome: All three phases planned and executed via worktree-isolated parallel agents across 13 total waves. PR #485 opened for Phase 42 (fully verified, live DB confirmed). Phase 43 is code-complete but has 4 runtime UAT items requiring a desktop+FUSE session. Phase 44 is fully complete. Working tree cleaned up.

repo: Kubo runs with the `server` profile and swarm port 4001 publicly exposed — DHT provider records are broadcast for every pinned CID, making CIDs discoverable by crawlers even though blobs are encrypted.
The unpin endpoint POST /ipfs/unpin has only JwtAuthGuard with no ownership check; any authenticated user (signup is open) can unpin any CID by passing a harvested CID with their own JWT.
BYO-IPFS unpin path was broken in both directions before Phase 42; the server-side guardedUnpin fix handles it for free since 'not pinned' is now swallowed.
Writable-share saves drop prunedCids without unpinning (shared-write.ts:450), so there is no legitimate cross-user unpin path — only the broken endpoint was the attack surface.

`pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X` silently breaks: pnpm inserts `--` and jest treats the flag as a positional path regex. Always use `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'` instead.

Web and SDK consumers typecheck against built dist packages, not source — after modifying a dep package (sdk-core, sdk) you must rebuild it before running tsc on consumers or you get false type errors.

GSD gap-planner agents can truncate ROADMAP.md catastrophically: a single agent edit dropped it from 658 lines to 25, silently losing phases 1–43. Always verify line count after any planner commit touches ROADMAP.md.
`gsd health` intentionally removes .planning/DEFERRED.md and .planning/REFACTORING.md — these deletions are expected and should be committed, not restored.

CI release-please bot adds a commit (`chore(release): set release targets for PR #N`) to feature branches immediately after PR creation — this is expected and branches will appear 1 commit behind origin.
1Password SSH commit signing requires `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true`; the gsd commit helper returns `"committed": false` as a false negative even when commits land — always verify with `git log`.

code.finding: Upload-compensation path fires a global pin/rm on a CID that content-addressed dedup may share with another user — this was the second non-malicious path to the cross-user unpin bug, now rerouted through guardedUnpin.

guardedUnpin implemented with pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)), transactional row-delete + refcount + pending_unpins outbox insert, then Kubo pin/rm post-commit as best-effort. Cross-user attempts return silent 2XX but increment the audit metric.
Drops prunedCids without unpinning — no legitimate cross-user unpin occurs here, confirming the only attack path was the bare endpoint.

Correct handle_release ordering after Phase 43: journal.put(844) → handle.cleanup(892) → reply.ok(894) → spawn(904) → journal.remove-on-success(943). The Err arm of prepare_result now returns EIO instead of acking the OS after fsync failure (CR-04). Background upload thread no longer calls journal.remove — replay on next mount is the authoritative cleanup (CR-08).
handle_mkdir: journal.put(534) inside closure before reply.entry(655); conflict arm now sends FsEvent::MkdirConflict instead of warn-only, and journal entry is cleared only on parent-publish success.

Had an orphaned journal.remove call in the background spawn thread that was misaligned with the Linux/macOS replay-only cleanup mechanism (CR-08). Required an inline orchestrator fix after the gap executor missed it.

Phase 44: caller previously received ipnsRecord and called batchPublishIpnsRecords; now receives { ipnsName, metadataCid, newSequenceNumber, prunedCids, publishedChildren } from the new CAS contract in sdk-core.

updateFolderMetadataAndPublish now returns publishedChildren (the merged set at successful publish) — critical for callers to use as baseChildren on the next write. Missing this return was a critical review finding that would have caused a one-write-later lost-update regression.

workflow: GSD worktree cleanup helper (cleanup-wave) must be run from the repo root, not from inside an agent worktree — running it from a worktree directory causes false base_mismatch errors because it resolves repoRoot from cwd.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun. When a wave fails partway through, write a reduced manifest containing only the remaining unmerged entries.
`rm -rf glob1 glob2` aborts the entire command if any glob misses — use separate single-path rm calls when removing optional directories like node_modules.

node_modules and .husky/_ untracked directories inside agent worktrees block the merge step — executor prompts should include explicit CLEANUP instructions to remove these before the plan is marked complete.
When a merge leaves MERGE_HEAD state (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step failed), `git commit --no-edit` concludes it; then manually remove the worktree and delete the branch.
nest build (NestJS) produces formatting-only diffs in openapi.json as a side effect — restore with `git checkout --` before merging a worktree that ran api:generate to avoid spurious diff noise.
Never run full monorepo test suites in orchestrators or subagents (RAM constraint); always use targeted patterns against specific packages.

friction: Three separate session-limit interruptions broke the execute-phase loop mid-wave, requiring context reconstruction and re-dispatch of already-running background agents.

1Password SSH commit signing failed multiple times with 'agent returned an error / fatal: failed to write commit object' — required asking user to restart 1Password app and retry with dangerouslyDisableSandbox:true on all subsequent git commits.
gsd commit helper returns `"committed": false` even when commits land, causing blind retries and double-commits until a verify-via-git-log discipline was established.
pnpm/jest `--` separator silently broke testPathPattern, causing multiple failed test invocations before the `pnpm exec jest` workaround was found.
ROADMAP.md was truncated from 658 lines to 25 by the phase-44 gap-planner agent, silently losing phases 1–43 across several subsequent tracking commits before the close-out caught it.
cleanup-wave false base_mismatch when run from the wrong cwd; not idempotent on partially-completed waves — required writing reduced manifests for each retry.
42-05 worktree merge left a MERGE_HEAD state requiring manual `git commit --no-edit` intervention after the automated merge step failed.
openapi.json formatting drift (564+ lines from nest build side-effect) blocked a clean worktree merge and required `git checkout --` to restore before proceeding.
prettier was mangling .planning/ docs (table pipes, markdown syntax) because no .prettierignore existed — required mid-execution interrupt to create one.
Cross-package TypeScript dist staleness produced 8 false type errors in the web package after gap-wave merge, requiring diagnosis and rebuild of sdk-core and sdk packages.
Accidental user text input ('touring wyatt web bossy') interrupted the execute-phase flow twice, requiring interruption handling and state reconstruction.
Phase 43 CR-08 Windows alignment was missed by the gap executor — required an inline direct edit by the orchestrator after re-verify surfaced it.
Planner socket connection error mid-session (plans 01-03 written, socket closed) required verifying filesystem state and spawning a continuation planner for plans 04-08.
open_items: Phase 43 has 4 runtime UAT items requiring a live desktop + FUSE mount session: journal survival after SIGKILL, park-notification render, mkdir-orphan survival, runtime ciphertext-only journal check. Run `/gsd-verify-work 43` from a desktop session.
PRs for Phase 43 and Phase 44 are pending: waiting for PR #485 to merge and Phase 43 UAT to clear, then rebase feat/fuse-write-durability onto new main before opening.
Phase 42 SECURITY.md is missing — `/gsd-secure-phase 42` was flagged during close-out but not executed.
Pre-existing REQUIREMENTS.md traceability gap: IPNS-05, IPNS-06, DB-01, DB-02, BYO-08 appear in the body but are missing from the traceability table. Predates this milestone.
Advisory code review findings not turned into gap plans: Phase 43 drift-report counter-vs-gauge, Phase 44 WR-01 remote-delete resurrection asymmetry and WR-05 version-op CAS gap.
BYO provider.unpin client-side wiring deferred from Phase 42 — server side fixed, but the client SDK/FUSE doesn't call provider.unpin on delete.
Pending-uploads UI (show queue count in tray, full pending-uploads panel) deferred from Phase 43 discussion.
Writable-share prunedCids leak deferred from Phase 43 — recipients retain CID knowledge after revocation.
Rust FUSE merge parity for Phase 44 deferred — three-way mergeChildren and ConflictError exist only in TypeScript sdk-core; the Rust FUSE layer has no equivalent conflict handling.
